verdict.rationale: Muse is a consumer agent used through the mobile app, the Mac app, or WhatsApp. It keeps working on scheduled goals after you close the app, but nothing in the evidence shows a CLI, a public API, or any way to invoke it headlessly or from a CI pipeline. Probes found the non-marketing surface auth-walled, with no published API spec and no MCP discovery or developer surface, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.
